title: Does Generative AI speak Nigerian-Pidgin?: Issues about Representativeness and Bias for Multilingualism in LLMs
reasoning: The paper focuses on linguistic representativeness and translation bias between different varieties of Nigerian Pidgin (WAPE vs. Naija). While it utilizes religious datasets (the Bible and JW300) as source material for evaluation, it does so to benchmark machine translation and multilingual capabilities, not to evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, theology, or ethics.
